# Theme Requirements Quality Checklist: Project Visual Theme and Design Tokens

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, and consistency of the visual-theme requirements
**Created**: 2026-08-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all common semantic visual roles explicitly listed, including surface, content, border, focus, success, danger, warning, information, disabled, and liability? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are typography, spacing, sizing, radius, and elevation requirements all represented in the specification? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Are positive, negative, warning, neutral, and credit-liability meanings all covered by explicit requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the future visual-mode extension point defined without accidentally including dark mode in the current scope? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK005 Are both user-facing consistency scenarios and maintainer extension scenarios included? [Coverage, User Stories 1 and 4]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Are the viewport boundaries of 320, 768, and 1280 CSS pixels clear enough to make responsive acceptance objective? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006 and SC-004]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the requirement that financial meaning cannot rely on color alone clear about the acceptable supporting cues? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK008 Are default, hover, pressed, focus-visible, disabled, invalid, and loading states distinguished consistently? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the exact token names and values intentionally identified as planning or implementation decisions rather than ambiguous omissions? [Clarity, Plan §Design Decisions]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the distinction between a structural border and a keyboard focus indicator explicit enough to avoid replacing one with the other? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005 and Data Model §Interaction States]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Do the light-mode assumption and the future-mode extension requirement remain consistent across the spec, research, and data model? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions and Research §Decision 4]
- [ ] CHK012 Do the local system-font decision and local-first privacy constraint agree without introducing an external asset dependency? [Consistency, Research §Decision 3 and Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK013 Does the plan's deferral of automated accessibility validation to `003-playwright` remain consistent with the spec's retained WCAG design requirement? [Consistency, Plan §Technical Context and Quickstart §Browser automation follow-up]
- [ ] CHK014 Are semantic financial roles described consistently in the spec and token model, especially positive, negative, and liability? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003 and Data Model §Semantic Color Tokens]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Can every functional requirement be traced to at least one acceptance scenario or measurable success criterion? [Traceability, Spec §FR-001–FR-010 and SC-001–SC-005]
- [ ] CHK016 Are the success criteria measurable without requiring a particular component implementation? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the requirement for no theme-induced horizontal scrolling measurable at the stated viewport widths? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the maintainer outcome of avoiding new common-purpose visual values specific enough to review? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Are narrow-screen, long-financial-value, and empty-state requirements addressed? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK020 Are adjacent error, warning, disabled, and focus states covered without relying on a single color distinction? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Are keyboard and reduced-motion requirements documented as design constraints even though automated validation is deferred? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3 and FR-007]
- [ ] CHK022 Are future-mode behavior and the absence of a current dark-mode requirement explicit rather than implied? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases and Assumptions]

## Non-Functional Requirements and Dependencies

- [ ] CHK023 Are WCAG AA contrast expectations stated as a quality target while their automated verification boundary is clearly deferred? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-008 and Plan §Implementation Sequence]
- [ ] CHK024 Are Angular SSR, hydration, no browser-only globals, and no runtime storage constraints documented? [Dependency, Plan §Technical Context and Research §Decision 6]
- [ ] CHK025 Are existing Tailwind/PostCSS dependencies and the absence of a required new runtime dependency explicit? [Dependency, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK026 Are the account setup experience and later financial features identified as consumers without expanding this theme feature into business behavior? [Scope, Spec §Assumptions and Plan §Scale/Scope]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after a reviewer confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they need clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- This checklist evaluates the written requirements, not whether the theme implementation works.
- `$speckit-implement` must not modify these reviewer-owned markers.
